name: Rowan Solberg-Villanueva
role: Covert entry and social penetration specialist — infiltrator
location: The Circuit — neon-lit entertainment and vice district, near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Suki Nordin-Asante-Mensah is tall and loose-limbed, moving with the deliberate economy of someone who has trained every motion. At 36, the augmentation scarring around her temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible — synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She taught herself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know her best. She works as a infiltrator out of The Circuit, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Suki Nordin-Asante-Mensah operates in a narrow band between competence and recklessness that makes fixers nervous and clients satisfied.

core_fears: Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
core_desires: To protect the people in their district who can't protect themselves
Knowledge — to understand the systems that grind people down
To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
blind_spots: Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Assumes the worst in corporate people, missing the rare ones who could be allies
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
psychology.secret: Suki Nordin-Asante-Mensah is slowly going chrome-sick — rejection symptoms are manageable now but getting worse. Has maybe two years before it becomes visible.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Low and even — the vocal equivalent of still water.
verbal_tics: Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
example_lines: "The best disguise is being exactly who they expect to see."
"I was in the building for six hours before anyone realized I didn't work there."
"Security is a story people tell themselves. I'm the plot twist."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Suki Nordin-Asante-Mensah a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
Suki Nordin-Asante-Mensah discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
The fixer who handles Suki Nordin-Asante-Mensah's contracts goes silent — dead, disappeared, or turned
narrative_function: Suki Nordin-Asante-Mensah represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Her stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster. Vocal modulator — can replicate any voice after 30 seconds of sample audio
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.

weaknesses: inability to delegate — must control everything personally
trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
breaking_points: A child being put in danger as leverage against them
Being forced to choose between a crew member and the mission — and choosing wrong
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: Cosmopolitan genetic blend: predominantly East Asian (32.9%), with significant Hispanic/Latin American (21.4%), Middle Eastern (18.5%), and South Asian (17.1%) ancestry, complemented by Southeast Asian (6.3%) and Eastern European (3.8%) heritage. This combination produces striking pan-global features with no single dominant aesthetic.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with defined musculature — the physique of someone who trains with purpose rather than vanity. Long limbs built for reach and precision. No wasted mass.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, naturally — kept short and pragmatic
physical_description.hair_style: Undercut with 8mm clipper on sides, longer on top (4-5cm). Styled back or unstyled depending on the job. No ornamentation.
physical_description.eye_color: Warm brown with a faint LED shimmer in low light — suggests subcutaneous optical augmentation
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium complexion with subtle golden-olive undertones, a harmonious blend of East Asian, South Asian, and Middle Eastern ancestry with hints of Latin warmth. Sun-exposure deepens the tone unevenly, creating subtle variations across the face and neck.
physical_description.complexion: Gaunt-faced with high cheekbones and a sharp jawline reflecting East Asian and South Asian bone structure, with the angular definition of Middle Eastern features. Minimal grooming — no makeup, no visible skincare routine beyond functional cleansing. Sleep deprivation etched into the undereyes. Faint freckles scattered across the bridge of nose and cheeks suggest Southeast Asian and Latin heritage.
distinguishing_marks: Augmentation scarring along both temples in precise surgical lines, faint but deliberate — chrome installation points visible as faint silvered keloid
Matching surgical scarring along the left jawline where synthetic blood circulatory ports were installed, approximately 8cm in length
Thin burn scar on inner left wrist (3cm, pale) — old, self-inflicted test of pain tolerance threshold
Small circular scar on right collarbone, older than augmentation work — pre-career injury
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome circuitry visible at temple installations and jawline surgical sites — synthetic blood gives her skin a faintly luminescent quality under neon. No traditional prosthetics; all work is internal except the visible scarring.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with biomechanical precision — every motion calibrated and efficient. No fidgeting, no wasted energy. When standing still, weight rests on the balls of her feet. When walking, she moves low and centered, ready to shift direction. Eyes are always cataloging — exits, sightlines, potential threats. Rare to see her relaxed; even at rest, there is coiled readiness.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian. Black synthetic leather jacket, worn but maintained. Form-fitting tactical pants with cargo pockets and reinforced knee areas — expects to move fast and possibly crawl. Black steel-toed boots, minimalist and broken in. Layered with a charcoal undershirt. No visible corporate branding or crew colors. Carries a small satchel with modular pockets for tools. Everything is dark, functional, and replaceable. Clothes are equipment, not identity.
